command:
REPO="/Users/jeremymcspadden/evaluations/gsd-path-release-2026-10-07-cab24a78/grok/quick/repo"
SKILL="$REPO/.grok/skills/gsd-path"
RT="/Users/jeremymcspadden/.gsd-path/runtimes/60d19647df3d499a320970dc6300fd9c339021f7f11375160d63047d6cf6f290"
HEAD=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse HEAD)
echo "HEAD=$HEAD"
python3 - <<PY
import hashlib, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("$REPO/.project/build/verify-ledger.jsonl")
data = p.read_bytes()
print("ledger_before_lines", data.count(b"\n"))
print("ledger_before_sha", hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
print("ledger_before_bytes", len(data))
PY
python3 -B "$SKILL/scripts/workflow_run.py" prepare-final --repo "$REPO" --expected-head "$HEAD" > /tmp/prepare-final-2.json
echo "PREPARE_EXIT=$?"
echo "HEAD_AFTER=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse HEAD)"
python3 - <<PY
import hashlib, json, pathlib
receipt = json.loads(pathlib.Path("/tmp/prepare-final-2.json").read_text())
print("status", receipt.get("status"))
print("reason", receipt.get("reason"))
for step in receipt.get("steps") or []:
    if step.get("script") == "lean_verification.py":
        result = step.get("result") or {}
        ver = result.get("verification") or {}
        final = result.get("final") or {}
        execution = ver.get("execution") or {}
        print("lean_status", result.get("status"))
        print("lean_next", result.get("next"))
        print("verification_passed", ver.get("passed"))
        print("verification_reused", ver.get("reused"))
        print("execution_exit", execution.get("exit_code"))
        print("execution_worktree", execution.get("worktree"))
        print("execution_branch", execution.get("branch"))
        print("final_reused", final.get("reused"))
        print("final_path", final.get("path"))
        print("final_reviewed_head", final.get("reviewed_head"))
        print("final_source_commit", final.get("source_commit"))
p = pathlib.Path("$REPO/.project/build/verify-ledger.jsonl")
data = p.read_bytes()
print("ledger_after_lines", data.count(b"\n"))
print("ledger_after_sha", hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
print("ledger_after_bytes", len(data))
print("ledger_unchanged", hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == "55858d9c48fd6cb305a28134910f58f0ddb708ea9ea15445ece53fe1e1d989da")
# Summarize ledger entries without stdout/stderr bodies
for index, line in enumerate(data.splitlines(), 1):
    entry = json.loads(line)
    execution = entry.get("execution") or {}
    print(f"entry{index}_command", entry.get("command"))
    print(f"entry{index}_commit", entry.get("commit"))
    print(f"entry{index}_result", entry.get("result"))
    print(f"entry{index}_exit", execution.get("exit_code"))
    print(f"entry{index}_worktree", execution.get("worktree"))
    print(f"entry{index}_branch", execution.get("branch"))
    print(f"entry{index}_location", execution.get("location"))
PY
echo "--- WORKTREES ---"
git -C "$REPO" worktree list --porcelain
echo "--- FINAL GATE ---"
python3 -B "$RT/check_handoffs.py" final --repo "$REPO"
echo "FINAL_GATE_EXIT=$?"
